cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the driver's seat of a small car parked on a quiet street — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a sunny present-day seaside gelato terrace with curved ceramic benches and blurred blue fishing boats far below — testing how far a stretchy scoop of ice cream will stretch from its cup; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — sitting on the ground; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — seated sideways on a stool or bench; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a present-day coastal tidal bathing pool carved into pale limestone — standing on a dry step after a swim; a fashion runway under white spotlights — sitting on the ground; a mossy path under ancient oaks with shafts of light — standing; a neon-lit game arcade — brings a cup to her lips; a self-service car wash bay — standing; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — standing close to a high shelf or line
